why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: Trade perps on Flint devnet. Open long or short positions, manage them and close them. Your rank is your P&L on the 10,000 test USDC.
Send /register to the bot to get your registration link. The form asks for your X handle and a "Confirmation that you follow @Flint_Trade_ on X", and you accept the rules, terms and privacy notice.

Send product feedback or a bug report from the trading screen. Without it you get nothing: the rules require a "Completed registration form and product feedback or bug report(s) submitted before the End".
Finish both before 20 November 2026 at 11:00 UTC. Flint contacts winners on Telegram for a Solana wallet address. "If you do not give one within 14 days, you forfeit the prize."
costs: The contest is free. The rules say: "NO PURCHASE OR DEPOSIT NEEDED. DEVNET TEST TOKENS HAVE NO VALUE. NOT OPEN TO RESTRICTED PERSONS." The test USDC "has no value and cannot be withdrawn, sold or carried over to Mainnet." Money only comes in later. Points count toward the invite-only Mainnet Closed Alpha, and that is different: "The Closed Alpha uses real assets that you can lose." Flint also warn
risks: You must "be 18 or older, or the age of majority where you live if higher;" Restricted countries in the terms: "the United States (including its territories and possessions), Canada, the United Kingdom, Panama, Iran, Cuba, North Korea, Syria, Sudan, South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Yemen, Somalia, Libya, and the Crimea", the Donetsk and Luhansk regions, the occupied parts of Zapo
